drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: Store closed Monday, 1 day of sales lost. Historical 7-day pattern implies ~14% weekly drop. One past occurrence; no similar closures observed.

adjustment.analysis: The store closure on Monday (2026-11-16) removes one day of sales. Given the product's weekly pattern and 7-day cycle, a 1-day closure implies ~14% sales loss. The baseline already reflects seasonal trends and recent performance. No promotions or price changes are active. The Thanksgiving effect is negligible (noise-adjusted x1.0). The classical model’s 1.00 is consistent with no strong driver. The closure is a clear, one-time event with measurable impact. Adjust downward by 14% with low confidence due to single occurrence.
